name: Medium Porosity Hair
description: Medium porosity hair falls between low and high porosities, absorbing moisture at a moderate rate. This type of hair is usually wavy or curly and requires balanced care to prevent dryness and overhydration.
characteristics: Absorbs moisture at an average rate
May feel dry if not properly hydrated
washing_frequency: Every other day or as needed
oil_recommendation: Use oils sparingly to avoid overhydration

morning_routine.action: Apply a small amount of leave-in conditioner

night_routine.action: Deep condition with a moisturizing mask

weekly_care: Trim split ends to maintain healthy strands
heat_styling_recommendation: Use heat protectant and limit heat styling
dont: Rely solely on water to hydrate your hair
Use very heavy or greasy products that can weigh down the curls

seasonal_care.summer: Stay hydrated and avoid excessive sun exposure
seasonal_care.winter: Increase moisture intake and use more hydrating products
seasonal_care.monsoon: Manage humidity with appropriate styling techniques

expert_tips: Listen to your hair's needs and adjust care routines accordingly.
Regular trims can prevent split ends and maintain healthy hair.
